summary: Single-engine Piper PA-28-235 crashed at about 8:11 a.m. in mountainous terrain near Swampy Pass in the West Elk Wilderness of Gunnison National Forest; the Gunnison Regional 911 Center received the crash report at about 9:20 a.m. and emergency crews located the wreckage in the remote wilderness area; all three occupants were found dead at the scene — Mark Hendrickson, 46, Alan Hendrickson, 15, and Case Hendrickson, 13, all of New Castle.
location: Near Swampy Pass, West Elk Wilderness, Gunnison National Forest
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; Gunnison Regional 911 Center; Gunnison County Coroner's Office; National Transportation Safety Board; U.S. Forest Service
notes: Freshness sweep run 38: PEOPLE + AeroCorner, both carrying the Gunnison County release, coroner identification, and NTSB crash time; some early reports spell the youngest victim's name 'Chase' — coroner identification gives 'Case'. NTSB and U.S. Forest Service investigating; cause not yet reported.
